title: top-up: Apple container egress containment
definition: Per-launch internal network for Apple `container`, with the allowlist proxy sidecar attached to both the internal and the external network so it is the only route out; a version-verified CLI capability check that refuses a runtime whose flags cannot be proven; per-control egress probe results where a probe that did not run is recorded as not-run and never as a pass; a scoped stale-resource sweep limited to containers and networks this worker created; and bounded recovery that refuses the launch rather than falling back to unrestricted networking.
